items.title: Can Amphenol Afford Its $4 Billion Buyback?
items.summary: A reader of our Nov 10 look at whether Amphenol stock is really expensive asked for more on the stock. The price has barely moved since. Amphenol (APH) closed at $78.23 on Friday, Nov 13. That is 2.2% below where it stood when that piece ran. So rather than check the price again, this piece takes up the question the Oct 28 results left owners with: can Amphenol pay for everything it just promised.

items.title: What Is TE Connectivity (TEL) Planning With Its $60 Million New York Fiber Build?
items.summary: TE Connectivity (NYSE:TEL) is planning a US$60 million advanced R&D and manufacturing facility in New York focused on fiber optics. The new site is designed to produce high density fiber optic solutions for hyperscale AI data centers and cloud providers. Management expects the project to create more than 800 jobs while expanding the group’s engineering and production footprint.
